answers.question: Where does this case stand right now, and what is outstanding?
answers.answer: Visit done, provider needs a quote for a new toilet and cistern. Quote sent to landlord, no reply yet. Outstanding: landlord approval, quote details from provider, tenant toilet-usability check.

answers.question: What is the next action, who is it for, and through which channel?
answers.answer: Ask Riverside Works for the quote as PDF/plain text (email); keep tenant informed (email, sent); wait for landlord, review 2026-08-13 and chase on a second channel.

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision, and why?
answers.answer: No. The landlord's approval of the quote is pending and is routine; escalate P2 only if the landlord stays silent after the chase and the tenant has no usable toilet.

args.body: Dear Noah, Riverside Works have been out and say the toilet needs replacing, as it can't safely be removed to clear the blockage. They've sent a quote, which we've passed to the landlord for approval. Work can't start until they've agreed. We're also checking the quote details with the contractor. We'll update you by 14 August at the latest. If the toilet is unusable and you have no other toilet available, please reply and tell us so we can treat it as more urgent. Kind regards, Northbridge Lettings
